title: PlatformStreamErasureRequested
description:
Payload of `platform.stream_erasure.requested.v1`: a producer asks Edge to erase specific
messages it published from the events stream.

The enclosing command envelope carries the requesting `producer` (`ratatoskr-chatgpt` or
`ratatoskr-claude`), `command_id` (the outbox id), `aggregate_id` equal to
`request_ref`, the deletion request's `correlation_id` and `tenant_id`
equal to `owner`. Delivery is at least once and Edge deduplicates, so a replay
erases nothing twice.

`validate()` runs on every deserialization.

owner.description: The owner whose published messages are erased.

request_ref.description: The deletion request this erasure belongs to. Its kind is `privacy_request`.

stream_sequences.description:
Stream sequence numbers of the messages to erase, as returned by the broker when the
producer published them: 1 to 500 entries, each at least 1 and at most 2^53 - 1, strictly
ascending.

EntityRef.title: EntityRef
EntityRef.description: A namespaced, polymorphic wire reference, serialized as `<kind>:<local_id>`. The kind vocabulary is open: an unrecognised kind is preserved verbatim. The local identity is opaque and need not be a UUID; when it is one it must be the canonical lowercase hyphenated spelling, so one identity has one reference. Equality is octet equality of `<kind>:<local_id>`: the kind is lowercase by grammar, and the local part is case-sensitive and never case-folded, because provider identities are case-significant. This rule is narrower than the `pattern` below, which cannot express it.

TenantRef.title: TenantRef
TenantRef.description: The owner of the data a record concerns, wire form `user:<uuid>`. The kind set is closed: a consumer that cannot understand the owner kind must reject the record rather than process it.
